lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-ordered grid posterior to the branchial slits, with spot diameter increasing and density decreasing as the pattern progresses toward the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs to create a series of anchor points in a coordinate-like matrix across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal linear features running horizontally along the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical transition from high-intensity specular highlights on the superior edge to lower-intensity shadows on the inferior edge.
